ORACLE_BASE_SKILLS: Channel Revelation — activate a Mystery Revelation (costs Revelation Charges)
Prophetic Insight — brief glimpse of possible futures; advantage on next action
Curse Manifestation — intensify Curse for benefits at increased limitations
Divine Sense — detect divine, undead, or extraplanar entities
Oracular Trance — prophetic visions related to a question or situation

ORACLE_HERO_PROGRESSION.tagline: Curse Boons III–V, Mystic Insight, Final Revelation

milestones.feature: Mystic Insight — minor Revelation or passive from your Mystery
Prophetic Surge (1/day free or extended Revelation)

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Ancestor
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Connection to ancestral spirits and legacy
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Echo Court (an ancestral spirit chorus that binds lineage across time)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you aid an ally who lands a critical hit, regain 1 Revelation Charge
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Excel at supporting allies through spiritual guidance and protection, calling upon ancestral spirits to enhance the party's capabilities while providing tactical advantages.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Often welcomed in civilized areas, their connections to positive divine forces making them valued advisors and healers.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Example Mystery: Ancestor — rulebook extract lines 75–125

level1.name: Ancestral Guardian
level1.description: Passive: spectral guardian grants +1 AC vs first attack each round and +5% resistance to mind-affecting effects. Once per long rest, intercept a single-target attack against an ally within 3 tiles (guardian takes the hit and vanishes until long rest).

tierI.name: Echo Voice
tierI.description: Passive: telepathy with allies within 5 tiles. Active: spend 1 charge to let an ally repeat their last failed roll (attack, save, or skill) with +2.

tierI.name: Ancestral Strike
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge to channel a warrior ancestor. Next weapon or touch attack deals +50% bonus weapon damage and stuns on crit.

tierI.name: Bloodline Sight
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge to reveal all undead, invisible, or ethereal creatures within 6 tiles for 2 rounds; they cannot benefit from concealment or stealth.

tierII.name: Spirit Walk
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: leave your body for 1 turn — intangible, move through walls/creatures, cannot be targeted, may cast a Revelation through your spirit at full range.

tierII.name: Echo Armor
tierII.description: +10% resistance to non-magical damage. Once per short rest, when reduced to 0 HP, an ancestral echo absorbs the blow and leaves you at 1 HP.

tierII.name: Ghost Chant
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges to inflict Dread on enemies within 3 tiles (−10% hit chance and saves for 2 turns).

tierIII.name: Bloodline Convergence
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, +2 actions per turn (Revelation or movement only); allies within 5 tiles gain +10% crit, +5% DR, immunity to Fear; cast 1 Revelation per round at no cost. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

mysticInsight.name: Ancestral Whispers
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on History checks and immunity to surprise. Once per day, consult ancestors for cryptic but useful guidance.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Echo Voice: affects all allies within range simultaneously
Enhanced Spirit Walk: duration increased to 2 turns
Enhanced Bloodline Convergence: no longer causes Exhaustion

propheticSurge.name: Ancestral Confluence
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, call all ancestors to cast any Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 turn after, all Revelations cost 1 fewer charge (minimum 0).

finalRevelation.name: Echo Crowned
finalRevelation.description: Maintain 3 passive ancestral spirits (offense, defense, utility). Once per day, cast any Revelation twice in one turn using different Echoes. Sacrifice an Echo to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.source: rulebook — Example Mystery: Ancestor (only full tier tree in player rulebook)

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Battle
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: The hard counsel of the battle line: courage held for others, command under fire, and fury made answerable to the living
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Hold the line where it is breaking, turn a companion's opening into a shared advantage, and spend divine fury to keep the company moving rather than to chase glory.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Earn respect among those who have stood beside them and caution among those who have seen a battle-oath carried too far; their conduct is judged by whom they bring home.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 23; Combat Strategy line 152
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: War Chorus (fallen champions of the Tenfold Cycles who speak through banner, blood, and battle-oaths)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you or an ally drops an enemy to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Omen of the Host
level1.description: Passive: you gain +1 to hit on your first attack each round, +5% resistance to fear, and cannot be surprised while conscious. Once per short rest, whisper a battle-oath to an ally within 3 tiles — they gain +2 initiative, advantage on their next attack, and +5% DR until the start of your next turn.

tierI.name: Vanguard's Step
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: you and one ally within 3 tiles may immediately move up to 2 tiles without provoking attacks; the ally gains +5% DR until start of your next turn and you both have advantage on opportunity attacks made before end of turn.

tierI.name: Host's Cry
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: allies within 4 tiles gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 2 rounds as the War Chorus roars through you; the first ally to drop an enemy while the cry persists regains 1d6 HP and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per cry).

tierI.name: Mark of the Doomed
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy you can see for 2 rounds — you and allies within 5 tiles gain +2 to hit and +10% crit chance against them; the first attack that crits the mark deals +1d6 bonus damage and the marked target cannot benefit from concealment until the mark fades.

tierII.name: Divine Fury
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: for 2 rounds, your weapon and touch attacks deal +50% bonus weapon damage and ignore 5% DR; the War Chorus roars through each strike — on a critical hit, the target must save or suffer Fear (−10% hit) until end of next turn, and your second attack during the fury may be made as a bonus action if the first hit.

tierII.name: Field Command
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 5 tiles may immediately take a reaction to attack, move, or activate a class feature; the War Chorus marks them with command — they gain +10% damage on that action, +5% DR until start of your next turn, and you may grant a second ally within 5 tiles a free 1-tile reposition without provoking before the command resolves.

tierII.name: Relentless Strike
tierII.description: Passive: when you miss with an attack, the War Chorus steels your next strike — gain +5% hit chance (stacks once) and +10% weapon damage if that attack hits. On a critical hit, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round) and the target must save or suffer Fear (−10% hit) until end of next turn.

tierIII.name: Fury of the Host
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +1 action per turn (attack or move only), +10% crit chance, and +5% DR as the War Chorus banners them — you gain +2 AC and immunity to Fear; once per round you may cast one Tier I Battle Revelation at no cost, and the first ally to drop an enemy each round regains 1d6 HP. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

mysticInsight.name: Battle-Seer's Eye
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on Perception and Initiative. Once per day, foretell an enemy's opening strike — you and one ally gain +2 AC against that enemy's next attack.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Host's Cry: bonus damage and DR extend to all allies within 6 tiles
Enhanced Divine Fury: affects a third attack
Enhanced Fury of the Host: no longer causes Exhaustion

propheticSurge.name: War Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the War Chorus speaks through you — cast any Battle Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, allies within 5 tiles gain +5% DR and +10% weapon damage as the host's banners flare; your next Tier I Revelation this encounter costs 0 charges.

finalRevelation.name: Avatar of the War Chorus
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, manifest three War Chorus banners (offense, defense, rally) around you for 3 rounds: +2 AC, +2 attacks per turn, and all Tier I Revelations cost 0 charges. Allies within 5 tiles gain +5% DR and +10% weapon damage as the host answers; sacrifice a banner to prevent a party member's death or restore all Revelation Charges. When the banners fall, restore 2 Revelation Charges.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Bones
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: The unfinished account of death: decay faced without ornament, the rest owed to the fallen, and power borrowed only from what cannot speak for itself
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Read the cost written in bone and breath, deny the enemy easy return, and use the dead's lingering force to shelter the living without mistaking command for ownership.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Met with unease, especially near graves and battlefields; those who travel with them learn to watch whether their care for the dead matches the power they wield.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 24; Combat Strategy line 153
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Pale Ledger (a chorus of unfinished deaths bound since the Binding of the Old God)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When an undead creature or a dying foe within 5 tiles perishes, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Grave Attendant
level1.description: Passive: undead within 3 tiles treat you as neutral unless attacked, and you gain +5% resistance to necrotic damage. Once per long rest, animate one corpse within 2 tiles as a skeletal servant (1 HP, 1 attack) for 3 rounds — it intercepts the next single-target hit meant for you before crumbling.

tierI.name: Bone Whisper
tierI.description: Passive: speak with corpses and recent dead as if under Speak with Dead. Active: spend 1 charge to learn one hidden truth a corpse witnessed before death; undead within 2 tiles must save or become unable to act until end of your next turn as the Pale Ledger speaks through the bones.

tierI.name: Marrow Drain
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: touch attack deals 2d6 necrotic damage and you heal for half damage dealt; undead targets take +50% damage and cannot regain HP until end of your next turn as the Pale Ledger tallies their debt.

tierI.name: Ashen Shroud
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: cloak yourself in grave-dust for 2 rounds — +10% DR vs non-magical damage, +5% necrotic resistance, and enemies within 2 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and −10% saves vs fear; when the shroud ends, corpses within 2 tiles cannot be raised as undead for 1 hour.

tierII.name: Ledger's Command
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: command up to 2 undead within 4 tiles for 2 rounds — each may attack once per round using your Revelation with +10% damage; commanded undead gain +5% DR and one may intercept the next single-target hit meant for you before crumbling (once per command).

tierII.name: Rotting Touch
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: touch attack inflicts Decay — target takes +25% damage from all sources and −10% saves for 3 rounds; the Pale Ledger tallies their rot — on a failed save they also cannot regain HP and corpses within 2 tiles of them cannot be raised as undead until Decay ends; if the target is undead, they take 2d6 necrotic immediately and you heal half.

tierII.name: Death's Threshold
tierII.description: When reduced below 25% HP, gain +10% necrotic resistance, +5% DR vs non-magical damage, and +1 to Revelation saves until healed above half HP (once per short rest) — the Pale Ledger marks you as owed, not finished; undead within 3 tiles hesitate to target you (−10% hit on their first attack each round while below threshold).

tierIII.name: Unfinished Chorus
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all enemies within 4 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) as the Pale Ledger sings their unfinished deaths — once per round drain 1d6 HP from one target (heal half or redirect half to an ally within 3 tiles); undead you control gain +10% damage and +5% DR, and corpses within 4 tiles cannot be raised as undead until the chorus ends. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% necrotic resist for 1 round).

mysticInsight.name: Ledger's Memory
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on checks to identify undead, poison, and disease. Once per day, consult the Pale Ledger for the name and cause of death of any corpse you touch.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Marrow Drain: also slows target movement by 1 tile
Enhanced Ledger's Command: affects 3 undead
Enhanced Unfinished Chorus: you may redirect drained HP to an ally within 3 tiles

propheticSurge.name: Death's Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, cast any Bones Revelation at no cost. For 1 round, you and allies within 3 tiles gain +10% DR vs necrotic.

finalRevelation.name: Ledger Unbound
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, open the Pale Ledger across the battlefield — all enemies within 5 tiles must save or suffer 25% max HP necrotic damage as unfinished deaths are tallied; you may raise up to 3 fallen corpses as loyal bone servants for 3 rounds (each may attack once per round and intercept one hit meant for you). Undead you control during the effect gain +10% damage and +5% DR.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Cataclysm
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Destruction, upheaval, and the perilous mercy of breaking what cannot endure
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Turn the battlefield's fractures into an advantage, bringing down positions that cannot hold while opening a hard-won path for allies through earthquake, storm, and fire.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Frequently met with fear or guarded respect: a Cataclysm oracle is remembered for the wall they broke, and for what stood behind it.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 25; Combat Strategy line 154
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Shattered Seal (the wound left when the Old God was bound in the Descent's deepest tier)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you deal area damage to 2 or more enemies with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Tremor Sense
level1.description: Passive: detect structural instability and hidden passages within 3 tiles, and +5% resistance to bludgeoning damage. Once per short rest, cause a minor tremor — enemies within 2 tiles must save or fall prone; on success they still suffer −1 movement until your next turn.

tierI.name: Shardburst
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt stone shards in a 2-tile burst centered on a point within 4 tiles — enemies take 1d6 bludgeoning and suffer −1 movement for 1 round; on a failed save they also fall prone if adjacent to a wall or rubble.

tierI.name: Gale of Unmaking
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: unleash a 4-tile line of forceful wind — enemies in the path take 1d6 bludgeoning, are pushed 1 tile, and suffer −1 movement until your next turn; mundane flames are extinguished and loose debris becomes difficult terrain for 1 round.

tierI.name: Fault Line
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: erupt a 3-tile line of cracked earth for 3 rounds — difficult terrain; enemies entering or starting turn there take 1d4 bludgeoning and must save or fall prone if adjacent to a wall; structures along the line may develop cracks (DM discretion).

tierII.name: Upheaval
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: erupt a 3-tile burst earthquake — enemies save or fall prone and take 2d6 bludgeoning damage; structures may crack (DM discretion); allies in the burst are immune to prone and gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the Shattered Seal's tremor passes through them.

tierII.name: Storm Crown
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: crown yourself in the Shattered Seal's storm for 2 rounds — at start of each of your turns, enemies within 3 tiles take 2d6 lightning or thunder damage (your choice) and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of turn; allies in the storm gain +5% DR vs ranged attacks and cannot be knocked prone by weather.

tierII.name: Instability
tierII.description: Passive: when you take damage from an enemy, you may spend 1 charge as a reaction to fracture the Shattered Seal's wound — deal half that damage back as force in a 1-tile burst (once per round); enemies in the burst must save or fall prone, and allies in the burst gain +5% DR until start of your next turn as the tremor passes through them.

tierIII.name: Seal's Fracture
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per turn create a 4-tile cataclysm zone (earthquake, storm, or fire — choose when cast) as the Shattered Seal weeps — enemies inside take 2d6 damage each round and suffer −10% saves; allies inside gain +5% DR and cannot be knocked prone by the zone; difficult terrain spreads 1 tile outward each round and structures inside may crack (DM discretion). After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

mysticInsight.name: Wound of Creation
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on checks involving geology, storms, or the Descent's unstable floors. Once per day, sense the nearest structural weak point within 10 tiles.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Shardburst: radius +1 tile
Enhanced Upheaval: allies in burst are immune to prone
Enhanced Seal's Fracture: duration increased to 3 turns

propheticSurge.name: Cataclysm Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Shattered Seal weeps through you — cast any Cataclysm Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, the next area effect you create this encounter deals +25% damage and enemies inside must save or fall prone; structures in the zone may crack (DM discretion).

finalRevelation.name: The Unbound Wound
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, tear open a fragment of the Shattered Seal and let its buried violence answer — create a 5-tile cataclysm for 3 rounds, dealing heavy mixed damage each round. You gain immunity to force and bludgeoning for the duration. After: Exhausted for 1 round.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Dream
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Illusion, waking unreality, and the shaping of perception
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Bend a contested moment toward doubt and misdirection, sheltering allies behind false certainty while foes struggle to trust what they see.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Met with equal fascination and reserve; a Dream oracle's counsel is valued, though few welcome a vision that unsettles an easy answer.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 26; Combat Strategy line 155
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Veiled Threshold (dreamers who walk between waking prophecy and the Hush beneath the First Song)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you impose a condition or illusion on an enemy, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

level1.name: Dreamer's Veil
level1.description: Passive: +5% resistance to charm and illusion, and advantage on saves vs sleep. Once per long rest, wrap an ally within 3 tiles in a waking dream — they become invisible until they attack or 2 rounds pass; their first attack from concealment this encounter deals +25% psychic damage.

tierI.name: Mirage
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: create an illusory duplicate within 3 tiles for 2 rounds — enemies must save to distinguish real from false when targeting you; on a failed save they strike the mirage instead, and the duplicate may move 1 tile each round without provoking as a free action.

tierI.name: Slumber Glimpse
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as they stagger through a waking dream; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the dream passes, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

tierI.name: False Memory
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: one creature within 3 tiles believes a brief false event occurred (e.g. ally fled, trap sprung, you already cast) for 1 round or until disproven; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative and cannot take reactions until the memory is shattered, and the next attack against them gains +2 to hit.

tierII.name: Shared Dream
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: you and up to 2 allies within 4 tiles enter a lucid dream-state for 1 round — each may reposition up to 2 tiles without provoking and gains concealment until they act; when the dream ends, the first enemy each dreamer strikes deals +25% psychic damage as the Veiled Threshold bleeds waking into nightmare.

tierII.name: Nightmare Lash
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: lash one enemy within 5 tiles with waking nightmare — 2d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; on failed save, target suffers Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 2 turns and cannot take reactions for 1 round; the Veiled Threshold shows you their dread — if they were already suffering Dread or fear, the lash deals +50% damage and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

tierII.name: Unreality
tierII.description: Passive: when an enemy misses you with an attack, 25% chance they strike an illusory echo instead (once per round). Once per short rest, when you would take damage from an attack, you may instead vanish into unreality — the attack misses, you reappear 1 tile away, and the attacker must save or suffer Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn.

tierIII.name: Threshold Collapse
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, enemies within 4 tiles suffer −10% hit chance and cannot benefit from flanking — allies within the zone gain +10% saves vs charm and fear; reality frays at the edges: once per round an enemy inside must save or believe an ally is absent (attacks vs that ally have disadvantage until disproven), and your illusions inside the zone require a second save to disbelieve.

mysticInsight.name: Lucid Oracle
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on saves vs sleep and illusion. Once per day, ask the Veiled Threshold one question — receive a symbolic but truthful vision.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Mirage: creates 2 duplicates
Enhanced Shared Dream: affects 3 allies
Enhanced Threshold Collapse: enemies cannot use reactions inside the zone

propheticSurge.name: Dream Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Veiled Threshold parts — cast any Dream Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all illusions you create require a second save to disbelieve, and enemies who fail their first save against your illusions suffer −10% hit until end of next turn.

finalRevelation.name: The Waking Lie
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, rewrite one battlefield truth for 3 rounds: designate up to 4 tiles as 'dream' — enemies treat allies there as absent; allies gain concealment. Reality reasserts painfully when it ends (enemies save or take psychic damage).

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Flame
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Fire, conviction, and the costly mercy of a flame that can burn or restore
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Carry decisive fire into a contested moment, striking the foe while preserving allies through hard-won, wrathful renewal.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Often met with caution or fear: a Flame oracle may be sought in a crisis, but few mistake their gift for a gentle one.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 27; Combat Strategy line 156
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Crown of First Flame (the shard-fire that crowned Tyrnathar's founder at the First Cycle)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you heal an ally or burn an enemy with a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

level1.name: Ember Mantle
level1.description: Passive: resistance to fire damage and +5% healing received. Once per long rest, ignite your ember mantle for 2 rounds — melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage on hit, you emit warm light in a 2-tile radius, and allies there gain +5% saves vs fear.

tierI.name: Wrathful Brand
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: mark one enemy with burning judgment for 1 round — your next attack against them deals +50% fire damage; if an ally attacks the marked target before the brand fades, they heal 1d6 and the target must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next round as cursed embers cling.

tierI.name: Purging Flame
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: touch one ally within 1 tile to end one disease or poison and heal 1d8 + your Charisma modifier; undead touched instead take equal fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round as cursed ash clings.

tierI.name: Passion's Rush
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: blaze up to 3 tiles in a line of harmless fire — enemies passed take 1d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −1 movement until your next turn; if you end adjacent to an ally, they gain +10% weapon damage and +5% DR for 1 round as embers cling to their weapons.

tierII.name: Crown's Burn
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: unleash a 3-tile burst of shard-fire — enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit until end of next turn; allies in the burst heal half the total damage dealt to enemies (minimum 1d6), and the Crown's embers cling — allies healed this way gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn.

tierII.name: Zealot's Renewal
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: one ally within 3 tiles regains HP equal to your Charisma modifier × level tier (minimum 1d8) but takes 1d4 fire backlash — wrathful healing; the Crown's embers cling — they end one minor poison or disease, gain +5% DR vs fire until start of your next turn, and adjacent enemies take 1d4 fire as cursed ash scatters from the renewal.

tierII.name: Undying Ember
tierII.description: Passive: when reduced to 0 HP, erupt in shard-fire — adjacent enemies take 2d6 fire damage and must save or suffer −10% hit for 1 round; you stabilize at 1 HP (once per long rest). Allies within 2 tiles heal 1d6 as embers scatter from the Crown's mercy.

tierIII.name: First Flame Convergence
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, your fire Revelations deal +25% damage and allies within 4 tiles heal 1d6 when you burn an enemy — you emit warm light and allies are immune to fear; the Crown's memory kindles: once per turn when you heal via wrathful fire, one ally within 4 tiles gains +5% DR until start of your next turn, and Zealot's Renewal backlash is suppressed during the convergence.

mysticInsight.name: Founder's Memory
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on History checks involving Tyrnathar and the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, invoke the Crown's memory to reroll a failed save vs fire or fear.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Wrathful Brand: mark lasts 2 rounds
Enhanced Crown's Burn: allies need not be in burst to receive healing
Enhanced First Flame Convergence: no backlash on Zealot's Renewal during effect

propheticSurge.name: Flame Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Crown of First Flame kindles through you — cast any Flame Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, your next wrathful heal this encounter deals no backlash and allies within 4 tiles gain +5% DR vs fire; burning enemies you hit take +10% fire damage until end of next turn.

finalRevelation.name: Crown Restored
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, manifest the Crown of First Flame for 3 rounds: +2 fire damage on all attacks, allies within 5 tiles regenerate 1d6 per round, and you may cast Tier I fire Revelations at 0 cost once per round.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Life
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Restoration carried past the first wound: overflow healing, protective blooms, and the stubborn work of keeping life present
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Keep allies standing through the hard center of a fight, turning restored strength into shelter and making a contested position briefly safe enough to endure.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Commonly welcomed where healing is needed, though their gifts are valued most by those who understand that preservation asks as much courage as violence.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 28; Combat Strategy line 157
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Verdant Resonance (living blooms that answer the First Song's call to mend what the Descent breaks)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you restore HP to an ally (any source), regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round)

level1.name: Bloom Ward
level1.description: Passive: allies within 2 tiles gain +5% healing received, and you gain +5% resistance to necrotic and poison damage. Once per long rest, sprout a protective bloom on an ally within 3 tiles — absorb next 10 + level damage, then wilt and scatter petals granting +5% saves vs fear for 1 round.

tierI.name: Overflowing Light
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: heal one ally within 4 tiles for 2d6 + your Charisma modifier; excess healing above max HP becomes temporary HP (max 10) for 2 rounds, and if any temp HP remains when it fades the ally ends one minor condition.

tierI.name: Resonant Seed
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: plant a resonant seed in a 2-tile zone within 4 tiles for 3 rounds — allies starting turn there heal 1d4 and end one minor condition; undead entering or starting turn in the zone take 1d4 radiant and must save or suffer −1 movement until end of turn.

tierI.name: Thorned Shelter
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: thorned vines erupt around one ally within 3 tiles — +2 AC, +10% DR, and +5% healing received for 2 rounds; the first melee attacker each round takes 1d4 piercing and cannot move away from the sheltered ally until end of turn.

tierII.name: Garden of Restoration
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: bloom a 4-tile garden of restoration for 3 rounds — allies inside regenerate 1d6 at start of turn and gain +5% healing received; undead inside take 1d6 radiant at start of turn and must save or suffer −10% hit; entering the garden ends one minor poison or disease on that ally (once each per garden).

tierII.name: Life Linked
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: link yourself to one ally within 5 tiles for 2 rounds through the Verdant Resonance — you may transfer up to half damage they take to yourself (after DR); while linked, they gain +5% healing received and +10% DR vs necrotic, and when you heal them through the link they heal an additional 1d4 as blooms echo between you.

tierII.name: Verdant Pulse
tierII.description: Passive: when you heal an ally below 50% HP, they gain +10% resistances and +5% healing received until end of next turn (once per ally per short rest). Once per combat, when an ally within 4 tiles would drop to 0 HP, a verdant pulse blooms — they stabilize at 1 HP and end one minor condition.

tierIII.name: Song of Mending
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, all allies within 5 tiles regenerate 2d6 at start of turn and cannot be reduced below 1 HP by a single hit (once each) — the Verdant Resonance sings through them; when an ally is stabilized by this song, they end one minor condition and gain +10% healing received until the song ends.

mysticInsight.name: Bloom Oracle
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on Medicine and Nature. Once per day, diagnose any affliction by touch and learn one countermeasure the Verdant Resonance suggests.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Overflowing Light: temp HP max 20
Enhanced Garden of Restoration: also removes poison/disease on entry
Enhanced Song of Mending: duration 3 turns

propheticSurge.name: Life Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Verdant Resonance sings through you — cast any Life Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, all healing you do is maximized and allies you heal gain +10% healing received until end of next turn; undead within 3 tiles of a healed ally take 1d4 radiant.

finalRevelation.name: Eternal Bloom
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, raise a sanctuary bloom for 3 rounds in a 5-tile zone — allies inside are stabilized at 1 HP instead of dying, heal fully over the duration, and gain immunity to necrotic. Ends with petals scattering (brief obscurement).

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Shadow
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Silence, concealment, and the disciplined use of fear against those who mistake darkness for safety
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Claim a quiet angle in the fight, isolate a dangerous foe in dread, and strike from concealment before the enemy can answer.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Regarded with caution: useful where discretion is necessary, but unsettling to those who fear what silence lets a person notice.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 29; Combat Strategy line 158
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Hush Beneath the Song (silence that gathers where even the Choir's echo fades — see the Marquis of Silence)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you strike an enemy who cannot see you or is suffering fear, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Umbral Cloak
level1.description: Passive: +2 to Stealth in dim light or darkness and +5% resistance to psychic damage. Once per short rest, shroud yourself in the Hush — become invisible until you attack or 2 rounds pass; your first attack from concealment this encounter deals +25% psychic damage.

tierI.name: Psychic Lash
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: ranged psychic strike within 5 tiles dealing 1d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; if the target cannot see you, deal +50% damage, inflict Dread for 1 turn (−10% hit/saves), and they cannot take reactions until end of next turn.

tierI.name: Fear's Whisper
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or suffer Fear for 2 turns (−10% hit, cannot approach you willingly); on a failed save they also cannot take reactions for 1 round and allies gain +10% crit chance against them while feared.

tierI.name: Shadow Step
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: teleport up to 3 tiles to a space in dim light or darkness you can see; you leave no sound and gain +25% damage on your next attack from concealment before end of turn.

tierII.name: Night's Embrace
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: 3-tile zone of deeper shadow for 3 rounds — allies inside gain concealment and +5% DR; enemies inside suffer −10% hit and −10% saves vs fear; the Hush deepens each round — the first attack you make from inside the zone each round deals +25% psychic damage, and enemies who enter must save or lose reactions until end of turn.

tierII.name: Mind Spike
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: drive a psychic spike into one enemy within 5 tiles — 2d8 + Charisma modifier psychic damage; on failed save, target cannot take reactions for 2 turns and suffers Dread (−10% hit/saves); if they were already feared, the spike deals +50% damage and you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

tierII.name: Silent Hunter
tierII.description: Passive: first attack each combat from concealment deals +25% psychic damage and inflicts Dread (−10% hit/saves) for 1 turn on hit. Once per round after casting a Revelation while concealed, slip through the Hush — move 1 tile without provoking and gain +10% crit chance on your next attack before end of turn.

tierIII.name: Hush Descends
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, suppress sound in 5 tiles — enemies cannot cast verbal components and suffer Dread; you and allies gain +10% crit from concealment — the Marquis's silence deepens: enemies who start their turn inside must save or lose their action to nameless dread (once per enemy), and your first psychic Revelation each turn from inside the zone costs 1 fewer charge (minimum 0).

mysticInsight.name: Shadow Oracle
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on Stealth and Insight. Once per day, read the hidden fear in one creature's heart — learn their greatest dread (DM provides truthful answer).

revelationMastery: Enhanced Psychic Lash: range +2 tiles
Enhanced Night's Embrace: allies gain +1 AC inside
Enhanced Hush Descends: duration 3 turns

propheticSurge.name: Shadow Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Hush Beneath the Song gathers — cast any Shadow Revelation at no charge cost. For 1 round after, you become invisible until you attack or end of next turn; your first attack from concealment during the effect deals +25% psychic damage and inflicts Dread (−10% hit/saves) on hit.

finalRevelation.name: Marquis's Glimpse
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, invoke the Hush for 3 rounds: you exist partially in silence — untargetable by ranged attacks, all psychic Revelations deal double damage, and enemies within 4 tiles must save each round or lose an action to nameless dread.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Stars
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Radiant clarity, foresight, and the difficult reading of a path before it closes
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Read a brief advantage in the dark and make it usable: mark the opening, guide an ally's hand, and bring precise radiance where a fight is about to turn.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Sought as advisers and navigators, but met with reserve by those who would rather not hear which choices the sky makes difficult to ignore.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 30; Combat Strategy line 159
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Celestial Concord (star-choirs that map fate's threads across the Tenfold sky)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When you grant advantage or reroll to an ally through a Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Starlight Mantle
level1.description: Passive: +1 to ranged attack rolls and Revelation saves at night or under open sky, and +5% resistance to radiant damage. Once per long rest, illuminate 4 tiles with starlight for 2 rounds — reveal invisible and ethereal creatures; allies in the light gain +2 to hit on their next attack.

tierI.name: Guiding Bolt
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: hurl a radiant bolt within 6 tiles — deals 2d6 radiant damage; the target glows with star-mark for 2 rounds and the next ally to attack them gains +2 to hit and +10% crit chance.

tierI.name: Fate's Glimpse
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: touch the thread of one ally within 5 tiles — they may reroll their next failed attack, save, or skill check with +2; if the reroll succeeds, you glimpse a second possible outcome and gain advantage on your next Revelation save before end of next turn.

tierI.name: Clarity
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: end charm, illusion, or fear on one ally within 4 tiles; grant +10% saves for 2 rounds and reveal the true form of any shapeshifted or invisible creature within 2 tiles of them for 1 round.

tierII.name: Constellation Mark
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: mark up to 2 enemies within 6 tiles for 3 rounds — allies gain +10% crit and +2 to hit against marked targets; the first crit each round against a mark deals +1d6 radiant and reveals the target through concealment until the mark fades.

tierII.name: Radiant Path
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: trace a line of star-fire up to 5 tiles — each enemy in the path takes 2d6 radiant damage and is marked with star-ash for 1 round; allies in the path heal half the total damage dealt (minimum 1d6); the Celestial Concord maps the route — you and one ally may shift 1 tile along the path without provoking before the radiance fades.

tierII.name: Omen Reader
tierII.description: Passive: at initiative, the Celestial Concord reveals which enemy has the highest attack bonus — you and one ally within 5 tiles gain +2 AC vs that enemy's first attack each round. Once per combat, impose −2 on that enemy's first attack and mark them with star-ash — allies gain +10% crit against them until the mark fades.

tierIII.name: Concord Alignment
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, allies within 5 tiles gain +10% hit, +10% crit, and advantage on saves vs charm and fear as stars align — the Celestial Concord reveals each ally's thread; once per turn you may grant one ally within range a reroll on a failed attack or save, and your Guiding Bolt and Constellation Mark effects extend +1 tile while alignment persists.

mysticInsight.name: Stellar Oracle
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on Astrology and Navigation. Once per day, read the sky (or a divination focus) for cryptic guidance on a party decision.

revelationMastery: Enhanced Guiding Bolt: also slows target 1 tile on hit
Enhanced Constellation Mark: affects 3 enemies
Enhanced Concord Alignment: duration 3 turns

propheticSurge.name: Star Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Celestial Concord aligns — cast any Stars Revelation at no charge cost. For 2 rounds after, allies within 5 tiles gain +2 initiative and +10% crit chance as star-threads map their paths; you may grant one ally within range advantage on their next attack before the alignment fades.

finalRevelation.name: Concord Unveiled
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, call the Celestial Concord for 3 rounds: you see all enemies' intents (no surprise, +2 AC vs their attacks), all Stars Revelations cost 1 fewer charge, and once per round an ally within 6 tiles auto-succeeds one save.

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_MYSTERIES.name: Time
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.theme: Measured delay, costly reversal, and the care required when one moment is allowed to answer another
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.combatRole: Turn a narrow instant into room for the party to act: steal tempo from an enemy, restore an ally's chance, and make one hard choice matter twice.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.reputation: Met with respect and reserve; their gifts are welcomed in a crisis, but few are comfortable owing a future moment to the Turning Spiral.
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.rulebookRef: Mysteries list line 31; Combat Strategy line 160
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.patron: Turning Spiral (keepers of causality at the edge where the First Song's echo bends back on itself)
ORACLE_MYSTERIES.prophecyTrigger: When initiative is reordered or an ally rerolls a failed roll through your Revelation, regain 1 Revelation Charge

level1.name: Spiral Echo
level1.description: Passive: you gain +2 initiative and cannot have your place in initiative order reduced below your current slot. Once per short rest, delay one spell, attack, or condition effect targeting you by 1 round — it resolves at the start of your next turn instead, and you may move 1 tile without provoking when it lands.

tierI.name: Moment's Pause
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: one enemy within 4 tiles must save or lose their next action as time snags around them; on a failed save they also suffer −10% initiative until end of next round and cannot take reactions until the pause resolves.

tierI.name: Echo Strike
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: after you hit with a weapon or touch attack, an echo of the strike repeats at half damage on the same target (no extra charge); if the echo reduces the target below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

tierI.name: Borrowed Beat
tierI.description: Spend 1 charge: one ally within 3 tiles may immediately move up to 2 tiles or cast one Tier I Revelation before the next enemy acts; if they move, they do not provoke until they stop, and you both gain +2 initiative until end of next round (once per combat).

tierII.name: Rewind Wound
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: touch ally within 1 tile — the Turning Spiral folds causality; undo the last instance of damage they took in the past round (restore HP, remove one condition inflicted by that hit if any); they gain +5% DR and +2 initiative until start of your next turn, and if the undone damage would have dropped them below half HP, you regain 1 Revelation Charge (once per round).

tierII.name: Temporal Rift
tierII.description: Spend 2 charges: open a 3-tile temporal rift for 2 rounds — enemies inside act last in initiative and suffer −10% hit on their first attack each round; allies inside gain +2 initiative and +10% DR vs effects that would reduce their actions; once per rift, when an ally inside fails a save, you may spend 1 charge to let them reroll with +2.

tierII.name: Paradox Skin
tierII.description: Passive: when hit, 10% chance the attack lands on a temporal echo instead (miss). Resistance to time, aging, and slow effects. Once per short rest, when an ally within 3 tiles fails a save vs a time or aging effect, you may absorb the effect — they reroll with +2 as causality snags around you.

tierIII.name: Spiral Convergence
tierIII.description: Spend 3 charges: for 2 turns, once per round rewind one failed ally roll within 5 tiles (attack, save, or skill) as if it never happened — the Turning Spiral folds causality; you gain +1 action per turn (Revelation or move only) and +2 initiative, allies rewound this way gain +10% DR until start of your next turn, and enemies who benefited from the undone roll must save or lose their reaction. After: Exhausted (−1 action, −10% resist for 1 round).

mysticInsight.name: Spiral Oracle
mysticInsight.description: Advantage on checks involving history, prophecy, or the Tenfold Cycles. Once per day, ask the Turning Spiral whether a specific action will provoke disaster (yes/no with cryptic hint).

revelationMastery: Enhanced Echo Strike: echo deals full damage
Enhanced Rewind Wound: can target self
Enhanced Spiral Convergence: no action restriction on bonus actions

propheticSurge.name: Time Prophecy
propheticSurge.description: Once per day, the Turning Spiral folds causality — cast any Time Revelation at no charge cost. Initiative resets with you acting first this round; for 1 round after, allies within 5 tiles gain +2 initiative and may reroll one failed save each as the spiral echoes backward.

finalRevelation.name: The Spiral Opens
finalRevelation.description: Once per day, open a causality spiral for 3 rounds: at start of each round, choose one — repeat last round's beneficial Revelation at no cost, or force one enemy to repeat their last turn's worst action against their allies. Allies remember all timelines.

ORACLE_SHARED_PROGRESSION.feature: Tier I Revelation (choose 1, 1 charge) + Curse Boon I
Mystic Insight — minor Revelation or passive from your Mystery
Prophetic Surge (1/day free or extended Revelation)

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Spiral-Touched
limitations: You sometimes respond to events before they happen, causing confusion in social situations
You occasionally experience time differently than others, potentially missing turns in combat (5% chance)
You cannot maintain concentration on mundane tasks for extended periods

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: See 1 round into the future during initiative (+3 initiative). Once per day, reroll a failed save as you briefly step outside the timestream.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to act out of turn once per combat. You gain resistance to time-based magic and aging effects.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be reduced to 0 HP, you may instead phase out of time for 1 round, becoming untargetable and regaining 25% of your maximum HP. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: You exist in multiple timestreams simultaneously, allowing you to make two different actions in a single turn once per combat. Enemies attacking you have a 10% chance to hit your echo instead, causing the attack to miss.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: You gain the ability to create a time loop, resetting an entire combat encounter to its beginning state once per day. All allies retain knowledge of the original timeline, allowing them to make different choices.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: rulebook — Example Curse: Spiral-Touched (only full curse tree in player rulebook)

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Wound Eater
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Lives by wounds taken from the living, never by an easy cure
limitations: Natural healing and healing granted by another restore only half their usual amount to you
Before each long rest ends, you must drain life from a living foe or gain Exhaustion
Your flesh carries a hollow, withered look that makes many mortals recoil at first meeting

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: When you hit a living foe with a weapon or touch attack, drain 1d6 HP; you heal for half the amount drained. Undead and constructs are immune.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: When you reduce a living foe to 0 HP, regain 1 Revelation Charge. Resistance to necrotic damage from non-Revelation sources.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Once per short rest, siphon a dying enemy's remaining HP as a burst heal (up to 25% of your max HP). The Pale Ledger records their final breath.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Drain aura: at the start of your turn, living enemies within 2 tiles take necrotic damage; you heal for the total drained. You may suppress this aura in civilized areas.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a conduit of the unfinished hunger — all living enemies within 4 tiles lose 25% max HP; you heal for half the total. Allies are unaffected.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Soul-Cracked
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: A fractured spirit refuses easy command and answers magic unevenly
limitations: Divination reads your aura and alignment inconsistently; even allies struggle to scry your intent
Once each encounter, the resonance type of your Revelations may shift without warning
Binding oaths and geas magic cause you physical pain until they are resolved

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Immune to charm and compulsion. Once per day, reroll a failed save against mind-affecting effects as your soul fractures around the blow.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: After rolling initiative, choose once per combat to shift the damage type of your next Revelation (fire, cold, lightning, necrotic, psychic, or radiant). Until that Revelation resolves, your aura reads as blank to divination — scrying your intent fails for the round.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When you would be charmed or dominated, reflect the effect onto the source (once per long rest). The source must save or suffer the effect instead.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Fractured soul: gain resistance to psychic damage and +2 to saves vs control. Divination targeting you has 50% chance to return contradictory results.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, shatter a binding curse, geas, or possession on yourself or an ally within 3 tiles. The broken magic lashes the originator for psychic damage.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Haunted
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Restless dead attend your steps, offering aid at a social cost
limitations: Restless spirits draw attention: you suffer −2 to Stealth in haunted places or crowded civilized areas
Spirits sometimes speak through you at inopportune moments; social checks may require a Wisdom save
You sometimes address people who are not yet present, unsettling those who witness it

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Spectral attendants grant +1 AC against the first attack each round. Once per day, a spirit whispers a warning — you cannot be surprised.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Once per combat, a bound spirit intercepts a single-target attack against you, absorbing up to 5 + level damage before dissipating. The spirit wails as it fades — the attacker must save or suffer −2 to their next attack as dread clings to them.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Spirits murmur of danger — you and allies within 3 tiles cannot be surprised while you are conscious. Echoes of the dead grant +2 to Insight checks nearby.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Summon a wailing chorus: enemies within 3 tiles suffer Dread (−10% hit chance and saves) for 2 turns. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, bind a hostile or friendly spirit to scout, speak with the dead at a distance, or deliver a prophetic message along a path you have walked. The spirit persists for 10 minutes or until it completes one task; when it returns, it whispers what it saw and one name you did not send it to find.

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Tongues
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Many voices share your speech, making truth harder to hear cleanly
limitations: Unless you suppress the curse, social checks with mortals who do not share your mystery tongue suffer −2
Even accurate prophetic speech is often misheard; listeners may hear what they fear
You cannot fully silence the chorus; concentrating on mundane tasks longer than 1 hour requires a Wisdom save

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Understand all spoken languages and read divine script fragments. Allies within 5 tiles gain +2 to Lore and Insight checks when you interpret for them.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Confounding babble: one enemy within 3 tiles must save or lose their next action, overwhelmed by overlapping voices. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Prophetic utterance — force one creature within 3 tiles to truthfully answer a yes/no question drawn from the Choir's echo. Once per day.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Polyglot surge: communicate with beasts, plants, and spirits for 1 hour as the First Song's vocabulary flows through you. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, speak a single Word in the tongue of creation — all who hear must save or obey one short command. Those who resist take psychic damage.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Burning Blood
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Air kindles your spilled blood into a fire that harms friend and foe alike
limitations: When slashing or piercing damage wounds you, you and adjacent foes take 1d4 fire damage as your blood sparks
You cannot benefit from cold-based healing or resistances; your curse rejects the chill
Open wounds glow faintly, imposing −2 to Stealth until treated or until you rest

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Resistance to fire. Melee attackers take 1d4 fire damage when they hit you with a weapon attack. Your wounds smolder briefly — enemies within 1 tile take 1 fire damage when your blood first ignites each round.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Spend 1 Revelation Charge to ignite your blood — your next Revelation deals +50% fire damage and cannot be extinguished by mundane means. While ignited, slashing and piercing damage against you no longer sparks fire on adjacent allies; the Crown's flame answers only to your will.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When your blood ignites from damage, allies within 2 tiles gain +10% weapon damage for 1 round as shard-fire answers your pain. You may extend the flare to 3 tiles by spending 1 Revelation Charge — enemies in the burst take 1d4 fire damage as embers leap from your wounds.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Blood flare: when reduced below 50% HP, erupt fire in a 3-tile burst (once per short rest). Enemies take fire damage; you are not harmed by your own flare.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, become a living pyre for 3 rounds — fire aura in 3 tiles; enemies take fire damage at start of turn; you heal 1d6 when an enemy takes fire damage from you. Allies in the aura gain fire resistance and treat your ignited blood as bright light that reveals hidden foes within 2 tiles.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: False Life
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Magic mistakes your living breath for death and answers accordingly
limitations: Healing spells cast on you without a successful Insight check have a 50% chance to fail; magic reads you as corpse-cold
Unless you suppress the curse, divination treats you as undead
Clerics of life-deities may hesitate to aid you without proof that you still breathe

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Advantage on saves vs death effects and negative energy. Once per long rest, when you would die, stabilize at 1 HP as your body feigns death perfectly.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Feign death perfectly for 1 minute — undead ignore you unless attacked; you remain conscious but motionless. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When reduced to 0 HP, remain conscious for 1 round before falling — you may move, speak, or cast one Revelation. Once per long rest.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Necrotic resilience: +10% DR vs necrotic and negative energy. Undead attackers have 10% chance to miss you entirely, sensing kinship.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, return from death's threshold — after 1 round of appearing dead at 0 HP, rise at 25% max HP with immunity to necrotic for 2 rounds. Undead within 3 tiles treat you as kin until you act, and divination cast during your feigned death returns false results of your choosing.
