ORACLE_CURSES.name: Shattered Mind
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Your thoughts divide into competing fragments that act before they agree
limitations: Concentration checks are at −2 as competing thoughts contend for control
In tense social scenes, make a Wisdom save or speak a prophetic fragment aloud on an impulse not wholly your own
After a long rest, make a Wisdom save or wake with fragmented memories of others' dreams

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Once per combat, take a bonus move or activate one Tier I Revelation as a bonus action (not both a full action and bonus action in the same turn). The fragment acting is not wholly yours — observers may hear you answer questions you were never asked.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Fragmented focus: +2 initiative; immune to being stunned. Your initiative roll may be made twice — take the higher result.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Split thought: maintain two Revelation effects simultaneously for 1 round without paying double charges. Once per combat.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Mind echo: reroll one failed Intelligence or Wisdom check per short rest. Prophetic fragments grant +2 to Insight when reading motives.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, act twice in a single round — second action may be a Revelation or move only. Each action uses a different fragment of your mind.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Consumed
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Your Mystery remakes your body until its element shows through
limitations: As you gain levels, your appearance shifts toward your Mystery's theme: flame hair, starlit eyes, bone protrusions, and the like
Some civilized NPCs react with fear or awe; concealing the change in formal courts requires ongoing effort
As your body changes, armor and gear must be refitted periodically (roleplay / downtime cost)

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Gain +5% resistance aligned with your Mystery's element or theme (fire, necrotic, force, psychic, etc.). Once per day, suppress visible transformation for 1 hour in civilized areas — the Mystery still leaks through divination.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Elemental skin: +1 AC while wearing light or no armor as your flesh hardens into mystery-matter. Unarmed strikes and natural weapons you wield count as magical and deal +1d4 thematic damage.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: Mystery infusion: weapon and touch attacks deal +1d4 thematic damage matching your Mystery. Revelation potency visibly bleeds into your strikes.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Partial transformation: ignore difficult terrain tied to your Mystery (fire walks, shadow steps, temporal stutter, etc.). Allies who follow within 1 tile during the same round may treat that terrain as normal ground until your next turn.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, fully embody your Mystery's element for 3 rounds — immunity to that damage type, +2 effective Revelation potency, and visible manifestation (aura, wings of flame, star corona, etc.). Allies within 2 tiles gain +1 AC as your transformation steadies the battlefield; suppression is impossible while the embodiment lasts.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_CURSES.name: Fate-Bound
ORACLE_CURSES.blurb: Foreknowledge marks your path, but each omen narrows the road ahead
limitations: You cannot voluntarily break a sworn oath or prophecy without losing 1 Revelation Charge and suffering psychic backlash
Major life choices may feel predetermined once you have seen the threads that lead to them
Trying to flee a foreseen disaster without confronting it imposes −2 to saves until you face the omen

boons.name: Curse Boon I
boons.description: Once per day, glimpse one likely outcome before a party decision — the ally acting gains +2 to the related check or save. You must speak the omen aloud; allies who heard it retain the bonus even if the party chooses a different path.

boons.name: Curse Boon II
boons.description: Fated dodge: once per combat, force an attack against you to reroll as fate rewinds the strike. You must declare after the roll but before damage.

boons.name: Curse Boon III
boons.description: When an ally within 5 tiles would critically fail a save, you may accept the failure on yourself instead (once per long rest). The thread binds to you.

boons.name: Curse Boon IV
boons.description: Thread of destiny: +2 to saves vs death, fate-altering magic, and effects that would remove you from a prophesied path. Once per long rest, reroll a failed death save as the Concord refuses to cut your thread early.

boons.name: Curse Boon V
boons.description: Once per day, declare a prophetic outcome — one ally within 6 tiles auto-succeeds their next save or attack as the Concord enforces the written thread. You must describe the outcome aloud before the roll; if the prophecy fails to come true by end of combat, you lose 1 Revelation Charge as the thread frays.

ORACLE_CURSES.source: Draft — Aethel lore, pending author review

ORACLE_REVELATION_CHARGES.note: Revelation Charges power Mystery Revelations (initially 3, maximum 7). Each Mystery has a Prophecy Trigger to recover charges.

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Mercy
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Mercy is a shelter kept open in the worst hour: protection, healing, and the preservation of life before vengeance can make another wound.
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Radiant — bonus radiant damage; heals nearby allies for a portion dealt
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Mercy — allies gain increased healing received and resistance to necrotic damage
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Miracle Veil — protective barrier; ally cannot drop below 1 HP for the duration (1/rest)
conductClause: Never refuse a genuine plea for healing or protection when the oath can answer it
Set the saving of life before the taking of it, even when anger makes the latter easier
Offer defeated foes the mercy their surrender can bear, without abandoning those still in danger
Do not raise lethal force against the innocent or defenseless; strength was given to stand between them and harm

revelationSpells.spell: Blessing of the Meek — heal + AC if HP < 50%
Ward of Shelter — allies +2 DR, resist fear
Channel Life — transfer HP from self to ally
Sanctify Ground — zone removes conditions each round
Grace Reversal — revive fallen ally if you fall to 0 HP

oathbreaker.name: Cruelty
oathbreaker.deathTouch: Life Drain AoE — steal life from all creatures around you
oathbreaker.aura: Healing Suppression — all healing within aura reduced by 50%
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Exsanguinate — drain life in large radius, heal self for damage dealt

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Grace Eternal — once per day, Miracle Veil extends to all allies within your aura for 1 round; any ally reduced to 0 HP in that round rises to 1 HP instead, heals 2d8, and gains resistance to necrotic until end of next turn; you may Lay on Hands once as a free action during the veil.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Vengeance
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Vengeance is judgment carried through the long road: fury disciplined into pursuit, execution held to a sworn account, and no refuge promised to the unrepentant.
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Necrotic or radiant — bonus damage vs marked foes; applies Vengeance Mark
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Judgment — marked enemies within aura suffer −1 saves and cannot hide from you
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Judgment Brand — doom mark on target; bonus crit damage and pursuit (1/rest)
conductClause: Pursue sworn enemies until justice is served or they surrender; let no convenience excuse a broken charge
Do not abandon allies to feed a private vendetta, for judgment that leaves the faithful behind is only rage
Accept the surrender of those who genuinely repent, and hold them to the peace they have asked for

revelationSpells.spell: Mark of Retribution — mark one foe within 30 ft on failed Wis save; +1d8 smite damage vs marked and advantage on opportunity attacks against them until end of next turn
Relentless Pursuit — ignore difficult terrain vs marked target
Sentence of Doom — smite deals max dice vs marked
No Escape — marked foes within 60 ft cannot teleport, become invisible, or use extradimensional travel; if they leave your aura, opportunity attacks against them have advantage until end of next turn
Final Verdict — marked foe at or below half HP within 30 ft saves or drops to 0 HP; on success, your next smite deals max dice and they cannot regain HP until end of next turn

oathbreaker.name: Malice
oathbreaker.aura: Fearbrand — allies near you suffer morale penalties
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Fearbrand — increased damage to wounded; spread fear

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Verdict Absolute — once per day, your Judgment Brand cannot be resisted: marked foes suffer max-dice smites, cannot teleport or become invisible, and if reduced to 0 HP you restore your full Lay on Hands pool; unmarked foes who witness the execution must save or become frightened until end of next turn.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Dominion
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Authority held as a public burden: law spoken plainly, judgment bound to truth, and rulership measured by the safety it keeps
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Radiant or psychic — bonus damage; compels truth on failed save; liars in aura suffer −1 saves until end of next turn
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Authority — allies +1 to Intimidation; enemies must save to lie within aura
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Heaven's Decree — command obey or suffer psychic damage (1/rest)
conductClause: Uphold legitimate law and order, but do not call convenience or cruelty a lawful charge
Speak truth when acting as arbiter, and hear the whole matter before you command another
Do not use authority for personal gain; a decree that serves only its speaker has already failed the oath

revelationSpells.spell: Compelled Truth — 10-ft zone where deception fails; oath-breakers take psychic damage on failed Charisma save
Binding Word — restrain on failed Charisma save
Law's Weight — 20-ft zone for 3 rounds; lawbreakers (those who lied in your aura this combat) save or half speed, −2 AC, and cannot benefit from haste or dash until zone ends
Decree of Submission — 30-ft command; target save or charmed (obey one command) or frightened (cannot approach you) for 1 minute; oath-breakers have disadvantage

Sovereign Mandate — allies in aura gain advantage on saves vs charm, fear, and compulsion for 1 minute; enemies who fail a Wis save when entering aura cannot lie in your presence until end of next turn

oathbreaker.name: Tyranny
oathbreaker.aura: Obey — psychic damage for disobedience within aura
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Obey — mass command with psychic backlash

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Sovereign's Ascendance — once per day, Heaven's Decree affects all enemies in aura without save; allies gain advantage on Charisma saves and +2 to Intimidation for 3 rounds, and enemies who fail cannot lie or disobey a direct command until end of next turn.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Flame
SACRED_OATHS.theme: A fire kept for cleansing rather than hunger: zeal tempered by restraint, corruption confronted, and renewal guarded after the ash
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Fire and radiant — bonus damage; purges one condition from undead/fiend on hit
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Purification — allies resist disease; undead in aura take radiant damage at start of turn
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Holy Inferno — AoE smite purge; fire and radiant damage (1/rest)
conductClause: Purify corruption and undeath where found, but name the thing being purged before you raise the flame
Do not burn the innocent in zeal; fire that cannot distinguish harm from shelter has forsaken this oath
Accept that fire renews as well as destroys, and remain to protect what must grow after the burning

revelationSpells.spell: Cleansing Brand — fire damage + remove curse on crit
Zealot's Flame — weapon ignites for 1 minute; attacks deal +1d6 fire and purge one disease from you on hit; undead in aura take 1d6 radiant at start of their turns
Purge the Tainted — zone damages undead each round
Sanctified Immolation — next smite or Holy Inferno ignores fire resistance and deals +1d6 radiant to undead; if target is cursed or diseased, purge one condition on hit
Phoenix Rebirth — when ally in aura drops to 0 HP, revive to half max HP with fire shield (resist fire, 2d6 fire to melee attackers) once per combat per ally

oathbreaker.name: Inferno
oathbreaker.aura: Scorch the Sanctified — remove buffs; block regeneration
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Scorch the Sanctified — AoE purge that harms allies

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Purifying Crown — once per day, manifest sanctified fire for 3 rounds: undead and fiends in your aura take radiant+fire damage each turn, allies gain immunity to disease and poison, and Holy Inferno immediately recharges once.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of the Ancients
SACRED_OATHS.theme: The living memory of the old places: nature guarded as a covenant, ancient power answered with humility, and renewal left possible for those who follow
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Force or radiant — bonus damage; roots target until end of next turn on crit; fey and elementals have disadvantage on saves vs your smites
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Remembrance — allies resist charm; fey/elementals hesitate to attack you
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Thorn Crown — reflect status effects back at attacker (1/rest)
conductClause: Protect ancient places and living memory, especially where no living voice remains to speak for them
Do not destroy what cannot be restored; power does not excuse a wound made for haste
Honor pacts with fey and primal spirits, and do not mistake an old promise for permission to command

revelationSpells.spell: Roots of Memory — 10-ft burst on smite hit; on failed Str save target restrained and you learn one fact about its origin (fey, elemental, or ancient place)
Primal Ward — allies in aura gain resistance to cold, fire, lightning, or thunder (choose at cast); fey and elementals have disadvantage on saves vs. your smites while ward persists

Echo of Ages — you and allies in aura gain advantage on saves vs charm and frightened for 1 minute; fey and elementals that fail a Wis save when entering aura hesitate and cannot attack until end of next turn
Standing Stone — 20-ft zone of difficult terrain for enemies for 3 rounds; fey and elementals save or are slowed; allies treat zone as normal terrain
Primordial Surge — allies in aura gain temp HP equal to 2× CHA mod from land; fey/elementals in aura save or are rooted until end of next turn

oathbreaker.name: Withering Grove
oathbreaker.aura: Lifeleech Bloom — remove regeneration and resistance
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Lifeleech Bloom — drain vitality from plants and allies

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Primordial Crown — once per day, Thorn Crown persists for 3 rounds without cost; roots on crit spread to adjacent foes, fey and elementals within aura cannot attack allies, and allies gain advantage on saves vs charm while the crown persists.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Silence
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Humility, watchful restraint, and strength held in quiet
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Psychic or radiant — bonus damage when you have not spoken since last turn
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Stillness — allies gain +1 to concentration; loud noises suppressed in aura
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Vow Unbroken — bonus smite if you stay silent this combat (1/rest)
conductClause: Speak when words serve the oath; let silence bear the rest
Do not claim glory for the work entrusted to you
Hear the whole matter before you judge it

revelationSpells.spell: Hush — silence one creature on failed save; if you have not spoken since combat start, target also suffers disadvantage on its next attack
Quiet Step — move silently; advantage on Stealth
Wordless Ward — shield ally without verbal components
Still Mind — immunity to charm and frightened while you remain silent this combat; if you break silence, allies in aura gain +2 concentration saves for 1 round
Silent Judgment — smite without alerting nearby foes; on hit target cannot speak or cast verbal components until end of next turn and you gain advantage on Stealth until you speak

oathbreaker.name: Silent Heretic
oathbreaker.aura: Null Command — prevent verbal casting in aura
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Null Command — mass silence with psychic damage

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Vow Absolute — once per day, Vow Unbroken lasts the entire combat if you remain silent; all smites deal +50% psychic damage, enemies within aura cannot cast verbal components, and the first smite each round does not break your vow of silence.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of the Chain
SACRED_OATHS.theme: A vigil of iron: martyrdom, warding, and the burden freely borne for another
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Radiant — bonus damage; when a bonded ally within aura takes damage, redirect up to CHA mod (min 3) to yourself once/round
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Bonds — allies within aura share 10% damage reduction
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Warden's Lock — lock enemies in zone; cannot leave without save (1/rest)
conductClause: Stand between the helpless and harm, even when the cost is yours to bear
Keep every ward entrusted to you; do not abandon the bound when danger closes
Take suffering freely to spare another, but never make a chain of their sacrifice

revelationSpells.spell: Linked Ward — mark ally within aura; as reaction when they take damage, redirect up to 2× CHA mod radiant to yourself; if you fall to 0 HP this round, ally gains temp HP equal to damage redirected
Chain of Duty — mark ally; teleport to them when they fall
Martyr's Share — take half ally's damage as reaction
Unbreakable Bond — chosen ally in aura cannot be charmed, frightened, or magically compelled; when they fail a save vs charm, you may take the effect instead once per round

Final Stand — for 1 round, absorb all damage dealt to one chosen ally in aura; if you fall to 0 HP from redirected damage, ally gains temp HP equal to your level and resistance to all damage until end of next turn

oathbreaker.name: Shackled Lord
oathbreaker.aura: Iron Leash — slow and control debuffs
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Iron Leash — bind enemies; steal their actions

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Unbroken Covenant — once per day, Warden's Lock expands to your full aura radius for 3 rounds; bonded allies share your AC, cannot be moved against their will, and when you redirect damage to yourself they gain temp HP equal to half damage absorbed until the lock ends.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Grief
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Sorrow, remembrance, and the duty of passage
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Necrotic and radiant — bonus damage; against a creature that killed an ally this combat, the smite deals +1d8 and applies Grief Mark (−1 attacks until end of next turn)
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Mourning — allies gain a bonus on saves against fear; undead suffer disadvantage within the aura
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Final Vigil — call upon a fallen ally's memory for one round (1/rest)
conductClause: Keep faith with the dead and with those they leave behind
Do not make sport of grief or profane a place of remembrance
Guide the departed toward rest; do not claim them for undeath

revelationSpells.spell: Dirge — 30-ft cone or single target; on failed Wis save target −2 attacks and cannot benefit from morale buffs for 1 minute; undead also take 2d6 radiant
Last Rites — touch or 30 ft on dying creature; stabilize and grant +2 death saves and resistance to necrotic for 1 hour; undead within 10 ft must save or be turned until end of next turn
Memorial Flame — conjure 30-ft memorial light for 1 minute; reveals hidden undead, grants allies +2 to death saves, and undead in light have disadvantage on attacks
Sorrow's Weight — 20-ft zone for 3 rounds; creatures save or half speed and 2d6 necrotic each round; undead fail save automatically
Echo of the Fallen — summon spirit of fallen ally within aura for 1 round; it makes one attack or grants chosen ally +2 AC as reaction

oathbreaker.name: Gravetongue
oathbreaker.aura: Dirge of Ruin — block resurrection and healing
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Dirge of Ruin — necrotic wave that prevents healing

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Dirge of Passage — once per day, Final Vigil can channel two fallen allies simultaneously for 2 rounds; undead in aura suffer vulnerability to radiant and cannot benefit from healing, and survivors gain +2 death saves while either spirit is active.

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of Chains Broken
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Liberty, the breaking of unjust bonds, and freedom guarded against a new tyranny
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Force or radiant — bonus damage vs oppressors and bound foes; on hit, target loses grapple or restraint until end of next turn
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of Liberation — allies resist restraint; escape grapple as bonus action once/turn in aura
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Righteous Quake — break bindings; AoE push and damage (1/rest)
conductClause: Break the bonds of the unjustly imprisoned, and do not turn liberation into license to abandon them
Resist every tyrant, including the one who would rule in freedom's name
Guard the newly freed from exploitation, for an open door is not yet a safe road

revelationSpells.spell: Break Bonds — touch or 30-ft ally; end one restraint or grapple; if ally was magically bound, +10 ft movement and advantage on next escape attempt until end of next turn
Liberty's Step — ignore opportunity attacks when moving to ally
Shatter Shackles — dispel magical restraint in area
Revolution's Cry — allies in aura gain +10 ft movement and advantage on saves vs restraint for 3 rounds; oppressors in aura save or lose reaction until end of next turn
Unbound Host — party in aura cannot be restrained or magically bound for 1 minute; when an ally breaks free, they gain +10 ft movement until end of next turn

oathbreaker.name: Unbound Flame
oathbreaker.aura: Reign of Ashes — prevent buffs and escape
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Reign of Ashes — chaotic fire that traps foes

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Liberty Unbound — once per day, Righteous Quake breaks all magical restraint on allies in aura, grants +10 ft movement and immunity to grapple for 3 rounds, and oppressors in the burst save or are pushed 10 ft and lose reactions until end of next turn.
SACRED_OATHS.source: Draft — Aethel Sacred Oath; bounded rulebook-tone pass only, with mechanics and revelation spells pending author review (see CONTINUITY_GLOSSARY: Sacred Oath / Revelation spells)

SACRED_OATHS.name: Oath of the Martyr King
SACRED_OATHS.theme: Stewardship, the burden of the crown, and sacrifice freely borne for those in your care
SACRED_OATHS.smiteType: Radiant — bonus damage; allies in aura gain temp HP when you smite; you may redirect 5 damage from one ally per round
SACRED_OATHS.auraEffect: Aura of the Crown — allies +1 saves; you may redirect damage from one ally per round
SACRED_OATHS.signaturePower: Crown of Embers — team-wide DR + damage redirection (1/rest)
conductClause: Bear the responsibility of command without treating those in your care as a means to your glory
Set the realm's need above personal gain, and spend your own strength before you spend another's
Never demand a burden you would not freely take upon yourself

revelationSpells.spell: Noble Bearing — allies within aura +1 to morale saves; when you smite, one chosen ally gains temp HP equal to half radiant dealt
Royal Decree — command one creature within 30 ft; on failed Wis save it kneels prone or moves up to its speed toward you; allies in aura gain +1 to morale saves until end of next turn
Burden Shared — distribute damage among willing allies
Throne's Grace — Lay on Hands and healing you grant reach full aura radius for 3 rounds; allies in aura heal +1 HP per die and gain +1 death saves while the grace persists
Last King's Gift — when ally in aura would drop to 0 HP, they drop to 1 HP instead and gain temp HP equal to your level once per combat per ally

oathbreaker.name: Usurper's Crown
oathbreaker.aura: Crownshatter Decree — damage required for healing
oathbreaker.blasphemousWord: Crownshatter Decree — steal boons from allies

SACRED_OATHS.finalOathGift: Crown Undying — once per day, Crown of Embers lasts 3 rounds without concentration; damage you redirect heals the ally for half absorbed, allies in aura gain +1 saves while the crown persists, and you may redirect from two allies per round.

Bard.resonanceInterface: Completing and consuming a 5-stack Crescendo vents 2 Dissonance; repeating the same spell does not count as rhythmic variety.
mechanics: Crescendo — Bard abilities played in rhythm build stacks; at 5, the next qualifying ability consumes the stack for an enhanced effect.

Cleric.resonanceInterface: Once per turn, spending 2 or more Conviction on a Rite or Invocation vents 1 Dissonance; prayer changes cadence instead of bypassing Resonance.
mechanics: Divine Favor — prayer, rites, and service to the chosen power generate Conviction, which empowers divine abilities.

Crimson Agent.resonanceInterface: Once per turn, spend 1 Blood Gauge while casting to prevent 1 Dissonance; the Agent routes Weave strain through blood rather than gaining free casts.
mechanics: Blood Mark — successful attacks and hemomantic techniques build Blood Gauge, spent to place/detonate Blood Marks or fuel Veinweaves.

Dragoon.resonanceInterface: If the Dragoon moved at least 20 feet before a Weave cast, reduce that cast's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0); Momentum carries the note through motion.
mechanics: Momentum Gauge — movement and successful attacks build Momentum for leaps, burst attacks, and defensive maneuvers.

Druid.resonanceInterface: Entering Shapeshift clears the Refrain counter because the Druid changes the body sounding the Weave; beast-form casting remains limited by class features.
mechanics: Shapeshifting — assume specialized beast forms with role-specific movement, defenses, and attacks; Circles unlock Hero and Arch forms.

Mage.resonanceInterface: A Nuke Chain requires different named spells of the chosen element; completing a three-spell chain vents 2 Dissonance. Repeating one nuke builds Refrain normally.
mechanics: Elemental Focus — specialize in Fire, Cold, or Lightning.
Nuke Chains — three consecutive spells of the chosen element enable an enhanced finisher.
Resonance Surge — trade casting sustainability for burst-damage rotations.

Monk.resonanceInterface: Spend 1 Ki when using a minor Weave technique to prevent 1 Dissonance from that technique; Ki and Resonance remain separate pools.
mechanics: Ki Flow — movement/attack chains, critical strikes, and defensive reactions build Ki for advanced techniques.
Stance System — switch combat stances once per round to change tactical function.
Unarmored Flow — mobility, initiative, and stance benefits reward fighting without armor.

Mirrorsage.resource: Echo Slots (3 → 5; ceiling rules may expand storage)
Mirrorsage.resonanceInterface: The first replay of a newly Mirrorbound Echo ignores Refrain Dissonance; repeating the same stored Echo builds Refrain normally.
mechanics: Echo Slots — captured monster abilities occupy finite Echo Slots until released.
Mirrorbind — copy a witnessed eligible ability from the current battle into an empty Echo Slot.
Charm Bind — temporarily turn a low-intellect creature into a Reflective Companion.

Oracle.resonanceInterface: Oracle does not track Weave Dissonance. Revelation Charges, the permanent Curse, and Prophecy Triggers are the Oracle's anti-spam architecture.
mechanics: Mystery — determines the Revelation tree, passive identity, and Prophecy Trigger.
Curse — a permanent affliction that also unlocks escalating boons.
Revelation Charges — Oracles do not use Resonance Points; Revelations consume and recover RC through Mystery-specific triggers.

Ranger.resonanceInterface: A successful weapon hit between spell casts clears Refrain and reduces the next spell's Dissonance gain by 1 (minimum 0), rewarding the Ranger's martial/primal cadence.
mechanics: Track Target — mark one quarry for increased pressure and unlock quarry-dependent techniques.
Weapon Synergy — alternating melee and ranged attacks grants follow-up bonuses.
Elemental Imbue — Fire, Cold, or Poison modifies weapon effects.
Druidic Arrow Combo — successful weapon chains unlock an enhanced primal arrow technique.

Shaman.resonanceInterface: Once per round, the first spell cast inside the Shaman's own active Totem aura generates 1 less Dissonance (minimum 0).
mechanics: Totem System — persistent battlefield structures project allied boons or hostile penalties.
Elemental Affinity — Fire, Ice, Air, or Earth attunement modifies Shaman techniques.
Flask Bomb System — Theurgist/Soothsayer paths convert elemental power into thrown tactical effects.

Soldier.resonanceInterface: No general Weave casting; class power is entirely positional and martial.
mechanics: Palisade System — deploy barriers that create cover, chokepoints, and controlled firing lanes.
Overwatch System — monitor a declared zone and react when enemies cross or threaten it.
Intercept & Brace — defensive positioning protects allies and stabilizes the line.

Thief.resonanceInterface: Once per round, a Weave trick cast while hidden ignores its first point of Refrain Dissonance; stealth changes delivery, not RP cost.
mechanics: Sneak Attack — exploit stealth, flanking, Bleed, Poison, or Disable states for bonus damage.
Poison System — apply tactical toxins as a bonus action, with stronger critical effects.
Utility Skills — lockpicking, trap disarming, stealth, and infiltration remain core combat-adjacent power.

Tinker.resonanceInterface: Once per short rest, route up to 2 Dissonance into an active device; that device becomes disabled until repaired or the next short rest.
mechanics: Mechanical Pet — command and customize an Anacite Drone companion.
Explosive Toolkit — prepare elemental and tactical bombs.
Deployable Devices — turrets, traps, and gadgets reshape battlefield space.

Warrior.resource: Mutation Slots + Serum Engine + Brutality Threshold
Warrior.resonanceInterface: No general Weave casting; mutations and serums are the Warrior's power engine.
mechanics: Mutation Slots — equip and swap adaptive mutations during rests.
Serum Engine — specialized serums trigger or fuel mutations.
Brutality Threshold — dealing and taking damage pushes the Warrior into enhanced mutation states.

Wizard.resonanceInterface: The first cast of each different prepared Spell Matrix in an encounter generates 0 base Dissonance; repeating a matrix builds Refrain normally.
mechanics: Spell Matrix System — prepare and study modifiable arcane matrices, trading spontaneity for the broadest controlled spell access.

Paladin.resource: Oath + Smite + Aura + Lay on Hands
Paladin.resonanceInterface: Smite, Aura, and Lay on Hands are Oath mechanics and do not generate Weave Dissonance. After a successful melee hit, the next Oath spell before the end of the next turn generates 1 less Dissonance.
mechanics: The Oath — chosen at Level 3; defines Smite type, Aura, signature power, Revelation spell list, and Conduct Clause.
Smite System — Oath-shaped empowered melee strikes.
Aura System — scaling passive zones tied to the Oath.
Lay on Hands — healing/cleansing pool equal to 5 × Paladin level.

Lich.principle: Force the Weave through accumulated Dissonance, accepting direct magical trauma rather than losing access to ranked casting.

Necromancer.principle: Use death, corpses, and bound undead as resonators while forcing spells through Dissonance that would stop an ordinary caster.
